method: Product Owner picked venues from the dish page's 'Search on Google Maps' results and sent Google Maps share links. Claude Code resolved each link (name + exact pin from the place URL, !3d/!4d), confirmed the street with an OpenStreetMap reverse lookup, and took the house number from the PO's screenshot or the listing name. Only name, address, pin and the place link are stored; no ratings, reviews, hours or photos (D79).

venues.name: Bánh mì que - Pate gia truyền Quán Mau Hải Phòng

dishes.evidence: Google Maps listing “Bánh mì que - Pate gia truyền Quán Mau Hải Phòng” names bánh mì que Hải Phòng; chosen by the Product Owner from the dish page's Google Maps search (2026-11-28).

venues.note: Pin from the Google Maps place link; OpenStreetMap places it on the same street (Phường An Hội Đông). House number from the PO's Google Maps screenshot / listing name.
